title: KestrelCare Trip Interruption Q&A: Counting the Failure Day
content:
**Rule.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts trip interruption reimbursement, the failure day itself is counted as follows: where the decision came more than the diagnosis-wait days of 2 days after the failure date, one day is added for the failure day; where the decision came within the 2 diagnosis-wait days and the facility is a Kestrel network facility, one day is taken off, counting starting the day after the failure date; otherwise no day is added or taken off.

The failure date, the decision date and the facility type are those on the plan's most recent approved claim decision entry. The day added or taken off changes the trip days before they are capped.

**The decision came 4 days after the failure. What happens to the trip days?** One day is added.

**The decision came the day after the failure, at a Kestrel network facility?** One day is taken off.

**The decision came the day after the failure, at a franchised dealer?** Nothing is added or taken off.

| Days from failure date to decision | Facility | Trip days |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | any | plus 1 |
| 0 to 2 | Kestrel network facility | less 1 |
| 0 to 2 | franchised dealer or independent licensed repair shop | unchanged |
